{{Short description|Norwegian physicist}}
[[File:Torbjørn Digernes.jpg|thumb|Torbjørn Digernes in 2009]]
'''Torbjørn Digernes''' (born 30 March 1947 in [[Ørsta Municipality|Ørsta]]) is a [[Norway|Norwegian]] physicist and [[professor]] of marine systems design.<ref>[http://www.esmu.be/studytours/previoustours/198.html ESMU: Torbjørn Digernes] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110706133943/http://www.esmu.be/studytours/previoustours/198.html |date=2011-07-06 }}, accessed 2010-10-07</ref>

He is a former [[rector (academia)#Norway|Rector]] of the [[Norwegian University of Science and Technology]] (NTNU)
He started as Rector from 1 August 2005.<ref>[http://www.universitetsavisa.no/ua_lesmer.php?kategori=nyheter&dokid=43410972931658.54794296 NTNU 2005-10-03: Møt vår nye rektor, Torbjørn Digernes] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110723184124/http://www.universitetsavisa.no/ua_lesmer.php?kategori=nyheter&dokid=43410972931658.54794296 |date=2011-07-23 }} {{in lang|no}}</ref> His successor is [[Gunnar Bovim]] who officially assumed the post 1 August 2013.<ref>[http://www.ntnu.edu/news/2012-news/new-rector Gunnar Bovim selected as new NTNU rector] (Press Release from NTNU 6 December 2012)</ref>

Digernes is a former student of the then [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] (NTH) as an engineering graduate of technical physics in 1972. He was awarded a [[Doctor of Philosophy]] degree in 1982 from the same institution within informatics, concerning technical-economical analysis of design and operation of fishing vessels.

His academic career started at the calculation centre at the [[University of Trondheim]] 1972-74, at Fishery Science Research Institute 1974-1986 and at MARINTEK from 1986-1990. From 1990-1996 he was employed at the [[European Space Agency]] space station program at the [[ESTEC|European Space Technical Centre]] in the [[Netherlands]]. In 1984 he became Professor II and in 1998 Professor in marine projecting. He was [[Dean (education)|Dean]] of the Faculty of Marine Technology from 1999 to 2001, when this was merged with three other faculties to create the Faculty of Engineering and Technology from 2002, where he also was Dean.

Digernes is a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ntva.no/index.php?option=com_club&view=member&id=102%3Adigernes-torbjorn&Itemid=60|title=Medlemmer: DIGERNES, Torbjørn|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=29 November 2012}}</ref>
